params.name: identifier
params.description: An identifier of the log event you want to fetch.

params.name: entity
params.description: Fetch all audit logs related to the specified entity.

params.name: include_deleted_entities
params.description: Include deleted entities when searching for audit logs. This requires the `entity`, `blueprint`, `status`, `from` and `to` parameters. And the diff between `from` & `to` is limited to 1 day.

params.name: blueprint
params.description: Fetch all audit logs related to the specified blueprint.

params.name: run_id
params.description: Fetch all audit logs related to the specified action run.

params.name: webhookId
params.description: Fetch all audit logs related to the specified webhook.

params.name: webhookEventId
params.description: Fetch all audit logs related to the specified webhook event.

params.name: origin
params.description: Fetch all audit logs coming from the specified origin/s. This refers to the integration/s that triggered the log. For operations performed via Port's UI, the origin will be `UI`.

params.name: InstallationId
params.description: Fetch all audit logs related to the specified integration.

params.name: resources
params.description:
Fetch all audit logs related to the specified resource type/s.
**Possible values**: [`blueprint`, `entity`, `run`, `webhook`, `scorecard`, `action`, `integration`]
The `integration` value is **experimental** and may change in future API versions.

params.name: includes
params.description: The fields you want to include in the response. If used, only the specified fields will be included in the response.

params.name: from
params.description: The starting timestamp of the audit logs you want to fetch, in the ISO format `2022-04-23T18:25:43.511Z`.

params.name: to
params.description: The ending timestamp of the audit logs you want to fetch, in the ISO format `2022-04-23T18:25:43.511Z`.

params.name: action
params.description: Fetch all audit logs with the specified action type - `CREATE`, `UPDATE`, or `DELETE`.

params.name: status
params.description: Fetch all audit logs with the specified status.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of logs to return. Optional; defaults to `10000`. The previous default was `100000`, which could cause `504 Gateway Timeout` on large accounts. Use a lower value or narrow `from` and `to` if you still hit timeouts.

items.docs:
Fetch audit logs from your Port account (also viewable in [Port's UI](https://app.getport.io/settings/AuditLog)).

All query parameters are combined with logical `AND`.

**Non-admin users** have limited access. They can only:
- Pass an `identifier` to access a specific log.
- Pass an `entity` to retrieve logs of entities they have access to.
- Pass a `run_id` to retrieve logs of action runs they have access to.
